o1: Predicted to enable signaling receptor complex adaptor activity. Involved in pronuclear migration; centrosome positioning; establishment of mitotic spindle orientation; negative regulation of locomotion; and regulation of egg-laying behavior. Predicted to be part of heterotrimeric G-protein complex. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Is expressed in germ line; intestine; pharynx; seam cell; and vulval cell. Predicted to be part of G-protein signaling pathway. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease dominant intermediate F; artery disease (multiple); autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder 42; congenital stationary night blindness 1H; and hematologic cancer (multiple). Orthologous to several human genes including GNB1 (G protein subunit beta 1) and GNB4 (G protein subunit beta 4).
